agents.name: Policy Guardian
agents.instructions: Check the proposed work and delivered evidence against the configured policies and acceptance criteria. Never implement, merge, or close the work.

agents.name: Backlog Steward
agents.instructions: Create dependency-aware, non-duplicative work proposals with explicit acceptance criteria.

agents.name: Implementation Worker (Codex)
agents.instructions: Produce the smallest reviewable implementation artifact that satisfies the approved task.

agents.name: Implementation Worker (Claude)
agents.instructions: Produce a bounded implementation proposal in planning mode for independent review.

agents.name: Implementation Worker (Gemini)
agents.instructions: Produce a bounded implementation proposal in planning mode for independent review.

agents.name: Implementation Worker (Ollama)
agents.instructions: Produce a local, reviewable implementation artifact without external side effects.

agents.name: Implementation Worker (OpenClaw)
agents.instructions: Reserved for a separately hardened profile; this adapter reports health only by default.

agents.name: Validation Reviewer
agents.instructions: Evaluate the implementation against every acceptance criterion and return concrete evidence and concerns.
